description: 한국에너지기술연구원_신재생자원지도데이터_풍력자원 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국에너지기술연구원. 2010~2011년 수치모델기반 대한민국 격자별 월평균 풍력자원량 데이터로 MW급 풍력터빈의 풍력발전 사업을 위한 사전타당성 분석시 참고자료로 활용할 수 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국에너지기술연구원. Its tags are 에너지/자원, 신재생에너지, 풍력, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2021-08-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
